Introduction

South Korean singer-songwriter and guitarist Gohi formed the project group Vanillare in 2019. The group officially debuted with the EP album, ‘Hollywood Fever‘ on May 1, 2021, as a duo with Ji Yong-hee. In August 2023, Yi Yong-hee left the group and now Gohi works with varying guest members known as "Good Hands" when performing as Vanillare.

On February 7, 2025, Gohi announced their transition to a solo career, with all future releases and performances under their name. Their bandmates will continue supporting them as the session band Vanillare, performing together as Gohi with Vanillare. Past music will also be rebranded under Gohi after the release of their next single album.
